ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "client_secret": p('mongo-db-sapi.security.client-secret'), "client_id": p('mongo-db-sapi.security.client-id'), "name": attributes.headers.name, "X-CORRELATION-ID": attributes.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID", "source": attributes.headers.source, "systemId": attributes.headers.systemId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- { basePath: p("zsmart-sapi.base-path"), host: p("zsmart-sapi.host"), port: p("zsmart-sapi.port"), method: "GET", path: p('zsmart-sapi.resources.billingBalance.path'), body: {}, headers: vars.billingHeaders default {}, queryParameters: { "msisdn": vars.billingParams.'CONNECTION_NUMBER', "accountCode": vars.billingAccount }, uriParameters: {} }

%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { status: "success", transactionID: payload.result.result.transactionID, accountNumber: vars.billingAccount, balances: payload.result.result.balDtoList map ((item, index) -> { balanceId: item.balID, balanceTypeCode: item.acctResCode, balanceTypeName: item.acctResName, balance: item.balance, effectiveDate: item.effDate, expirationDate: item.expDate, lastUpdateDate: item.updateDate }) }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var totalCount = sizeOf(vars.billingBalanceAcc default []) default 0 var successCount = sizeOf(vars.billingBalanceAcc default [] filter ($.payload.status == "success")) default 0 var failedCount = sizeOf(vars.billingBalanceAcc default [] filter ($.payload.status == "failed")) default 0 var successAccounts = vars.billingBalanceAcc default [] filter ($.payload.status == "success") default [] var failedAccounts = vars.billingBalanceAcc default [] filter ($.payload.status == "failed") default [] --- { "codeResponse": if ( failedCount == 0 ) "200" else if ( failedCount < totalCount ) "207" else "500", "messageResponse": if ( failedCount == 0 ) "OK" else if ( failedCount < totalCount ) "PARTIAL_SUCCESS" else "FAILED", "accounts": successAccounts map $ - "status", "failedAccounts": failedAccounts, "summary": { "totalAccounts": totalCount, "processedAccounts": successCount, "failedAccounts": failedCount } }
